# ST-1: median of an even-length list

`median([1, 2, 3, 4])` returns 3. It must return 2.5: for an even number of values,
the median is the mean of the two middle values. Odd-length lists must keep working.

**Acceptance:** a test covers an even-length list.
diff:
diff --git a/stats.py b/stats.py
index 4d80832..3f73346 100644
--- a/stats.py
+++ b/stats.py
@@ -7,4 +7,7 @@ def mean(xs):
 
 def median(xs):
     s = sorted(xs)
-    return s[len(s) // 2]
+    mid = len(s) // 2
+    if len(s) % 2 == 0:
+        return (s[mid - 1] + s[mid]) / 2
+    return s[mid]
diff --git a/tests/test_stats.py b/tests/test_stats.py
index 1a84d67..6c362fd 100644
--- a/tests/test_stats.py
+++ b/tests/test_stats.py
@@ -7,3 +7,7 @@ def test_mean():
 
 def test_median_odd():
     assert median([3, 1, 2]) == 2
+
+
+def test_median_even():
+    assert median([1, 2, 3, 4]) == 2.5
